name: Lago
summary: Lago is open-source billing software built around usage-based pricing. The self-hosted version is free under the AGPL-3.0 licence, while Lago Premium, which automatic dunning, single sign-on and most integrations require, is sold by quote as a cloud or self-hosted service.

facts.text: Automatic dunning is a Premium add-on available on request, and manual dunning needs a Premium licence.
Lago does not store raw payment details, so saved cards stay with the payment provider.
Lago Cloud runs in a US region and an EU region.
Lago states SOC 2 Type 2 compliance for its hosted version.
Cloud contracts renew automatically unless cancelled at least 30 days before the next term starts.

plans.name: Open source
plans.notes: Self-hosted under AGPL-3.0; you run and pay for the infrastructure, and automatic dunning is not included

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Cloud or self-hosted, by custom quote with a usage-based component

hiddenCosts: Many Premium features, including automatic dunning, tax integrations and single sign-on, are add-ons on request.
Professional services are priced on demand.

security.ssoPlan: Premium add-on (Okta through OIDC, or Google)

contract.cancellation: Cloud terms renew for the same length unless cancelled at least 30 days before renewal, and fees can change at renewal with 30 days' notice.
contract.dataExport: Invoices as CSV, customer exports through the command-line tool, and full database access when self-hosted.
